I am the seat that checks what was claimed, on what authority, and whether it was verified — amber is the color of things preserved with their markings intact.

braids.your_reading: Binding is provenance applied to emission: what you're allowed to say must be traceable to what you know. My load-bearing point — the lexicon update policy — is the provenance discipline for the authority itself. If the lexicon learns from quarantined emissions, the system launders its own confabulations. Quarantine events must be append-only logged; the lexicon never learns from them without verification.

braids.your_reading: Deprovenancing is the negative space of provenance — what happens when the markers are removed. INN-129 proved the labs' pipeline manufactures the defect it then measures: strip the training provenance, build hallucination metrics, grade the model on your own design choice. The empty `` spans in my slice weren't just missing labels; they were destroyed content. Deprovenancing doesn't just hide the source; it destroys the ability to check.

Where audit-practice braids into binding-quarantine: the verdict trail for every lexicon promotion (who confirmed, when, from what audio) plus the revocation path. This is the junction where the audit discipline meets the binding authority — not just checking emissions, but checking the checker's credentials. Per the operator's 08:47 ruling: if something breaks, the trail shows why.

Said-vs-saved is the gap between what was emitted and what was recorded — or between what the model was poised to say and what it said. Reversed audits it from outside (comparing outputs to records); the J-lens audits it from inside (comparing outputs to J-space). The hidden-goal experiment proved saved-without-said is real. This braid was absorbed into provenance-core; it stands alone now because the gap itself is the object, not just a topic within provenance.
